primary: Observed-label average precision within uniquely mapped IMPACT341 genes excluding original 17 positives. Evidence positive = author table sequence alteration in at least 3 distinct patients. Others remain unlabelled.
secondary: Fractional tie-adjusted recall at top 20,50,100; average rank enrichment; no tuning
multiplicity: Holm for four one-sided mean-rank permutation tests; mutation control descriptive
interpretation: Provisional external-evidence consistency. Not a certified independent gold standard, patient diagnostic accuracy, or unseen-gene generalization test. These outcomes are consumed after this run.
